comment: Free-LLM provider rotation for the task worker. Two gates, both fail-closed. (1) Human approval: a provider may only run agentic work when tier is 'approved'. (2) Numeric floor: min_agentic_coding_score is MiniMax-M3's measured 47.4, the owner's stated quality bar. Providers marked 'utility' are fine for short non-agentic jobs (titles, summaries) and are never selected for issue implementation.

quality_policy.note: Scores are percentiles within each benchmark, weighted toward current agentic leaderboards (BenchLM agentic 0.30, SWE-rebench 0.20, AA Intelligence 0.15, SWE-bench Verified 0.10). A model needs >=2 components and at least one agentic evaluation to receive a score at all; avg_agentic_coding_score_arena_only never satisfies this floor.

providers.note: Owner-pinned primary 2026-10-31 (owner chose MiniMax M3.1 Flash as runner model). No measured agentic score yet; owner_pinned bypasses the score floor. NIM probe 200 in 1.9s.
